name: Adam And Eve Disobey God
overview: The account of Adam and Eve's disobedience reveals the entrance of sin into the world through the subtle deception of the serpent, who questioned God's command and tempted Eve with the promise of becoming like God, knowing good and evil. This act of rebellion brought spiritual death and enmity between the serpent and humanity, ultimately fulfilled in the promised seed who would overcome evil. The consequences of this first sin extend to all mankind, as death passed upon all because all have sinned, highlighting the need for redemption through Christ.
